acceptanceCriteria: Bound count-derived allocations and loops before constructing shard missing-index lists or repeat observation slots, retaining a named refusal for oversized input.
Add bounded tests for huge shard totals and repeatEach without allocating at attacker-selected scale; retain all normal acceptance cases.
body: Confirmed expansion on reviewed HEAD 45d1cb07dbf13075920f4faf1d174b01890c572f for GH #809/#810. Runtime: Go 1.27.2 darwin/arm64. Change shard-1-of-3.json config.shard.total to 100000; Parse succeeds and Stability constructs 99999 missing shard indexes from one small report. The same input can specify an arbitrarily large platform int. reader.go:278 only checks positive/range and shards.go:75 loops to the declared total; compare.go:423 similarly materializes repeatEach slots with no upper bound. MaxRuns=64 and MaxTests=50000 do not constrain these fields. Expected: count-controlled processing has a finite documented bound and oversized values yield REPORT_BOUND_EXCEEDED or another named refusal. Safe probe used 100000, not a memory-exhausting value. Reproduction: temporary overlay TestReviewProbe/large_shard_total.

completion.reason: Codex round-1 finding fixed: declared shard totals and repeatEach are bounded at 1024 (REPORT_BOUND_EXCEEDED) and compare counts absent repeat slots without allocating them; regression tests added. Codex round 2 PASS. Delivered in beamfall/corvint#816, merged to main at 469f260b8. Tests on go1.27.2: the batch's focused packages PASS, go vet clean, doc gates PASS, CEM check and seal PASS. full-gate (make gate) NOT_RUN (owner scoped-work preference). Evidence: sha256 of the lane build-log record at the merge commit.
